tenders.title: Procurement, Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning Of Asset Performance Management System (APMS) As Per PPMC Specification No. DS-01:2026 On Turnkey Basis
tenders.scope_summary: This tender seeks a contractor for the procurement, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of an Asset Performance Management System (APMS) on a turnkey basis, adhering to PPMC specification No. DS-01:2026. The system aims to enhance operational efficiency and equipment health monitoring within the power sector.
key_points: Compliance with PPMC specification No. DS-01:2026.
Includes procurement, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning.
Electronic submission of bids is likely (not explicitly stated for this specific tender, but common for Pakistan tenders).

tenders.title: Supply and Installation of Asset Performance Management System for Pole Mounted Distribution Transformers
tenders.scope_summary: Sukkur Electric Power Company (SEPCO) is inviting bids for the procurement, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of an Asset Performance Management System (APMS) specifically for Pole Mounted Distribution Transformers. This aims to improve the monitoring and management of critical distribution assets.
key_points: Procurement, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of APMS.
System specifically for Pole Mounted Distribution Transformers.
Open to eligible national and international bidders, firms, and joint ventures.
Follows National Competitive Bidding (NCB) and Single Stage One Envelope bidding procedure.

tenders.title: 3D Laser Scanning of Heritage Sites in Velika Hoča/Hoçë e Madhe and Letnicë/Letnica in Kosovo
tenders.scope_summary: This tender seeks services for 3D digital documentation of heritage assets in two villages in Kosovo, Velika Hoča/Hoçë e Madhe and Letnicë/Letnica. The scope also includes a detailed condition survey of the historic Micić winery for future restoration.
key_points: Focus on Velika Hoča/Hoçë e Madhe and Letnicë/Letnica villages in Kosovo.
Includes detailed condition survey of Micić winery.
Aim is for future restoration planning.
Deadline extended and Clarification Note no. 1 published on 17.09.2026.
